title: Algor's Terror Dome (Quest)
description: Algor's Terror Dome (Quest) — The Townstons wiki
html:
Quest Giver: Townston Commander

Quest Type: Discover

Quest Description: Find the Algors Terror Dome Base Camp and enter Algor's Terror Dome

Quest Reward: 7500 Gold

Return to: Townston Commander

Repeatable: No

Following Quest: An Explorer's Task (Algor's)

Last Build Updated: 155

In-game text

Journal text, offer, and turn-in as they appeared in game.

Journal: Go Forth, Dungeon Runner, to Algor's Terror-Dome! Then, Return to the Townston Commander in Townston.

Offer:

Beyond Algernon is a wild and uncultivated region that marks the beginning of Algor's Terror-Dome. You have proven yourself to be tough enough to venture out unto this area. Sissirat guards one way that is located in the depths of Algernon that leads into the Base Camp of Algor's Terror-Dome. I have also heard of a portal that resides on Algernon - Level 5, which will also take you into Algor's Terror-Dome Base Camp.

Once you have explored Algor's Terror-Dome return to me, the Townston Commander, here in Townston for your pay.

Turn-in:

Well, what did you think? How was it? You know, there are rumors that Algor's Terror-Dome is actually a living dungeon. I wonder if that's true...

Objectives:

  • Algor's Terror-Dome Base Camp
  • Algor's Terror-Dome

Level range: 10–25
